stages.name: supplied_rows

stages.name: supplied_functions

stages.name: function_flags
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7450_versioned_revert/|l8100_ops_analytics/)') OR f.__path IN ('impl/common/l7300_revision_history/revision_history_query_impl.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_lazy_mixin.py') OR rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7200_versioned_transactions/_lint_|impl/common/l7300_revision_history/_lint_)') sensitive,
rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'bootstrap|ddl') bootstrap,
rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'reconcile|reconciliation|schema_ensure') OR f.__path IN ('l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py','l2000_connection/table_existence_authority.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/schema_ensure.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_schema_services.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_free_functions.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_mixin.py') reconciliation FROM supplied_functions f

stages.name: delegate_targets

stages.name: architecture_edges

stages.name: reachable
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE reach(__path,root,path,node,first) AS (SELECT __path,id,__path,id,NULL FROM function_flags UNION SELECT r.__path,r.root,e.target_path,e.target,coalesce(r.first,e.__start) FROM reach r JOIN architecture_edges e ON e.__path=r.path AND e.fn=r.node WHERE r.path=r.__path) SELECT * FROM reach

stages.name: graph_functions
stages.query: SELECT f.* FROM function_flags f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_flags later WHERE later.symbol=f.symbol AND later.fact_order>f.fact_order)

stages.name: graph_edges
stages.query: SELECT owner.__path,owner.symbol src,target.symbol dst,e.visit_key ordinal,e.__start location FROM architecture_edges e JOIN graph_functions owner ON owner.__path=e.__path AND owner.id=e.fn JOIN graph_functions target ON target.__path=e.target_path AND target.id=e.target

stages.name: graph_categories
stages.query: SELECT 'plan' kind UNION ALL SELECT 'intent' UNION ALL SELECT 'native' UNION ALL SELECT 'dolt' UNION ALL SELECT 'orchestration'

stages.name: local_graph_events
stages.query: SELECT c.kind,e.__path,e.fn,e.__start location,e.visit_key,e.channel FROM function_events e JOIN graph_categories c ON c.kind=e.category OR c.kind='orchestration' AND e.category='plan' AND e.detail NOT GLOB 'native_cursor.*'

stages.name: graph_sinks
stages.query: SELECT NULL __path,kind||':'||symbol id,location FROM (SELECT e.*,f.symbol,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.symbol,e.kind ORDER BY e.visit_key,e.channel) chosen FROM local_graph_events e JOIN graph_functions f ON f.__path=e.__path AND f.id=e.fn) WHERE chosen=1

reachability.roots: SELECT c.kind||':'||f.__path __path,c.kind||':'||f.symbol id,f.fact_order ordinal FROM function_flags f CROSS JOIN graph_categories c
reachability.edges: SELECT c.kind||':'||e.__path __path,c.kind||':'||e.src src,c.kind||':'||e.dst dst,e.ordinal,e.location FROM graph_edges e CROSS JOIN graph_categories c

reachability.roots: SELECT f.__path,f.symbol id,f.fact_order ordinal FROM function_flags f WHERE f.pure
reachability.sinks: SELECT NULL __path,target.symbol id,target.__start location FROM graph_functions target WHERE target.legacy

reachability.roots: SELECT f.__path,f.symbol id,f.fact_order ordinal FROM function_flags f
reachability.sinks: SELECT NULL __path,target.symbol id,target.__start location FROM graph_functions target WHERE target.symbol IN ('l4000_permissions.lazy_permission_support.check_object_write_permission_lazy','l4000_permissions.lazy_permission_support.check_upsert_conflict_write_permission_lazy','l4000_permissions.lazy_permission_support.check_write_permission_lazy','l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement.check_object_write_permission','l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement.check_write_permission')

stages.name: rollups
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id root,c.kind category,r.location FROM graph_rollups r JOIN graph_categories c ON c.kind=substr(r.__path,1,instr(r.__path,':')-1) AND c.kind=substr(r.root,1,instr(r.root,':')-1) JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=substr(r.__path,instr(r.__path,':')+1) AND f.symbol=substr(r.root,instr(r.root,':')+1)

stages.name: intrinsic
stages.query:
SELECT __path,id,location,reason FROM (
      SELECT f.__path,f.id,e.__start location,
        CASE e.category WHEN 'context' THEN 'ExecutionContext terminal ' WHEN 'internal' THEN 'reads LazyResult internals ' WHEN 'state' THEN 'writes execution-derived planner state ' WHEN 'private' THEN 'reaches through private runtime state via ' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'direct eager sink ' ELSE 'imperative native call ' END||e.detail reason,
        row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY CASE e.category WHEN 'context' THEN 0 WHEN 'internal' THEN 1 WHEN 'state' THEN 2 WHEN 'private' THEN 3 WHEN 'plan' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,e.visit_key,e.channel) chosen
      FROM function_flags f JOIN function_events e ON e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id WHERE e.category IN ('plan','native') OR f.sensitive AND e.category IN ('context','state','private') OR f.sensitive AND e.category='internal' AND f.name NOT IN ()
      ) WHERE chosen=1 UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.__start,CASE WHEN f.legacy THEN 'legacy eager wrapper' WHEN rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND NOT f.pure THEN 'async function' ELSE 'name ends with _async' END FROM function_flags f
      WHERE (f.legacy OR rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND NOT f.pure OR f.name GLOB '*_async') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_events e WHERE e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id AND (e.category IN ('plan','native') OR f.sensitive AND e.category IN ('context','state','private') OR f.sensitive AND e.category='internal' AND f.name NOT IN ()))

reachability.roots: SELECT f.__path,f.symbol id,f.fact_order ordinal FROM function_flags f WHERE f.pure AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM graph_legacy l WHERE l.__path=f.__path AND l.root=f.symbol)
reachability.sinks: SELECT NULL __path,f.symbol id,i.location FROM intrinsic i JOIN graph_functions f ON f.__path=i.__path AND f.id=i.id

reachability.roots: SELECT f.__path,f.symbol id,f.fact_order ordinal FROM function_flags f WHERE f.is_lazy AND NOT(f.pure AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM graph_legacy l WHERE l.__path=f.__path AND l.root=f.symbol))
reachability.edges: SELECT e.* FROM graph_edges e WHERE e.dst NOT IN ('_internal.dynamic_import.load_python_module','l2070_batching.lazy_runtime.build_visible_whole_document_embedding_write','l5200_vector_index.index_implementations.pgvector._vector_dimension_mismatch_from_pgvector_error')
reachability.sinks: SELECT NULL __path,f.symbol id,f.__start location FROM graph_functions f WHERE NOT f.is_lazy

stages.name: transitive_matches
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id root,r.location eager,r.node target,i.reason FROM graph_eager r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.symbol=r.root JOIN graph_functions target ON target.symbol=r.node JOIN intrinsic i ON i.__path=target.__path AND i.id=target.id

stages.name: non_lazy_matches
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id root,r.location,r.node target FROM graph_nonlazy r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.symbol=r.root

stages.name: legacy_matches
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id root,r.location FROM graph_legacy r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.symbol=r.root

      WHEN d.issue='LA-008' THEN f.qualname||'/'||f.qualname||'_async use different sync vs async execution machinery'
      WHEN d.issue='LA-006' THEN f.qualname||' passes _conn to '||d.detail||'() instead of the plan owner'
      WHEN d.origin='defer' THEN 'defer_lazy_result is forbidden; publish a real ServerPlan step/ref instead'
      WHEN d.origin='compat_import' THEN d.detail||' is forbidden in ServerPlan-sensitive files; use explicit steps/refs instead'
      WHEN d.origin='compat' THEN d.symbol||' is a forbidden lazy compatibility surface in ServerPlan-sensitive files'
      WHEN d.issue='LA-009' THEN f.qualname||CASE d.origin
        WHEN 'delegate' THEN ' delegates lazy execution to eager method '||(SELECT target.qualname FROM delegate_targets delegate JOIN function_flags target ON target.symbol=delegate.target WHERE delegate.__path=d.path AND delegate.fn=d.fn AND delegate.__start=d.start_byte AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_events event WHERE event.__path=target.__path AND event.fn=target.id AND event.category='plan') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM call_targets call WHERE call.__path=target.__path AND call.fn=target.id AND rx_extract(call.target,'[^.]+$',0) IN ('ddl_effect_lazy','execute_grammar_leaf','execute_grammar_leaf_async','fetchall_grammar_leaf','fetchall_grammar_leaf_async','fetchone_grammar_leaf','fetchone_grammar_leaf_async','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_execute','grammar_execute_async','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_value_lazy','scalar_grammar_leaf'))) ORDER BY delegate.keyword_start LIMIT 1)||' (direct eager sink)'
        WHEN 'context' THEN ' hides eager execution behind an ExecutionContext terminal'
        WHEN 'internal' THEN ' peeks into LazyResult internals outside sanctioned runtime helpers'
        WHEN 'state' THEN ' writes execution-derived planner state instead of surfaced refs'
        WHEN 'private' THEN ' reaches through private runtime state instead of surfaced dependencies'
        ELSE ' reaches eager downstream function '||taint.target||' ('||taint.reason||')' END

      WHEN d.issue='LA-017' THEN f.qualname||CASE d.origin
        WHEN 'reconciliation' THEN ' uses reconciliation '||(SELECT event_kind FROM function_events e WHERE e.__path=d.path AND e.fn=d.fn AND e.__start=d.start_byte AND e.category=d.origin LIMIT 1)||' surface '||d.detail||'(); gather schema facts through a closed observation ServerPlan step and build reconciliation DDL from SchemaStateSnapshot'

      WHEN d.issue='LA-009' AND d.origin='context' THEN 2 WHEN d.issue='LA-009' AND d.origin='internal' THEN 3
      WHEN d.issue='LA-009' AND d.origin='state' THEN 4 WHEN d.issue='LA-009' AND d.origin='private' THEN 5
      WHEN d.issue='LA-011' AND d.origin!='hydration' THEN 6 WHEN d.issue='LA-011' THEN 7
      WHEN d.issue='LA-012' THEN 8 WHEN d.origin='delegate' THEN 9
      WHEN d.issue='LA-002' THEN 10 WHEN d.issue='LA-003' THEN 11 WHEN d.issue='LA-004' THEN 12 WHEN d.issue='LA-005' THEN 13
      WHEN d.issue='LA-006' THEN 14 WHEN d.issue='LA-007' THEN 15
      WHEN d.issue='LA-013' AND d.origin='forbidden_pure' THEN 16 WHEN d.issue='LA-013' AND d.origin='legacy' THEN 17
      WHEN d.issue='LA-009' THEN 18 WHEN d.issue='LA-013' THEN 19 WHEN d.issue='LA-015' THEN 20 WHEN d.issue='LA-016' THEN 21
      WHEN d.issue='LA-017' AND d.origin='' THEN 22 WHEN d.issue='LA-017' AND d.origin='reconciliation' THEN 23
      WHEN d.issue='LA-017' AND d.origin='absence' THEN 24 WHEN d.issue='LA-017' THEN 25
      WHEN d.origin='payload' THEN 26 WHEN d.origin='dynamic' THEN 27 ELSE 28 END)>17 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM graph_legacy legacy WHERE legacy.__path=f.__path AND legacy.root=f.symbol))) d
